scene.ko: 해외에서 온 손님에게 사무실을 간단히 보여 주며 층별 부서와 편의 시설을 안내한다.

lines.en: Welcome to Dasol Tech, Mr. Grant. How was your flight?
lines.ko: 다솔테크에 오신 걸 환영합니다, 그랜트 씨. 비행은 어떠셨어요?
alt: Welcome to Dasol Tech, Mr. Grant. Did you have a good flight?

lines.en: Long, but fine. I slept most of the way.
Glad to hear it. Before the meeting, would you like a quick tour of the office?
lines.ko: 다행이네요. 회의 전에 사무실을 간단히 둘러보시겠어요?
alt: Good to hear. Would you like a short tour of the office before the meeting?

lines.en: This is where our design team works. Our engineers are one floor up.
lines.ko: 여기는 디자인팀이 일하는 곳이에요. 엔지니어들은 한 층 위에 있어요.
alt: Our design team is on this floor, and the engineers are upstairs.

lines.en: It's a very open space. How many people work here?
lines.ko: 아주 탁 트인 공간이네요. 여기서 몇 명이나 일해요?

lines.en: About a hundred and twenty in this office. The restrooms are down the hall, and there's a café on the first floor.
lines.ko: 이 사무실에서는 120명쯤 일해요. 화장실은 복도 끝에 있고, 1층에 카페가 있어요.
alt: Around 120 people. The restrooms are at the end of the hall, and the café is on the first floor.

lines.en: And here's our meeting room. My manager will join us in a few minutes.
lines.ko: 그리고 여기가 회의실이에요. 팀장님이 몇 분 뒤에 오실 거예요.
alt: This is the meeting room. My manager will be here in a few minutes.

expressions.note: 멀리서 온 손님에게 하는 첫 질문

expressions.en: Would you like a quick tour of ___?

expressions.note: 한 층 아래는 one floor down

expressions.en: ___ will join us in a few minutes.
